headline: Chile government and public-sector unions agree on 4.6% pay rise
summary: The Chilean government and public-sector unions signed a 4.6% wage increase agreement on November 27, matching the current inflation rate. Three federations did not join the agreement.
why: Public sector wage deals in Chile serve as a benchmark for broader labor market inflation expectations and fiscal expenditure planning.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Wage increases impact government fiscal spending and inflation expectations.
